subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram provider intermittently stalls despite stable direct Bot API connectivity

question: Should Telegram proxy reliability be fixed now with a shared scheme-aware proxy-agent repair, or should maintainers require fresh live reporter proof before accepting proxy contract changes?
rationale: The source and Undici contract make the SOCKS path plausible, but the remaining change affects compatibility-sensitive shared proxy behavior and the open candidate PR is incomplete.

options.title: Review a shared proxy repair
options.body: Use the open candidate or a replacement to fix explicit and env SOCKS/HTTP/HTTPS proxy handling with tests and live Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Require fresh live proof first
options.body: Keep this issue open but wait for reporter or maintainer reproduction from a current-main SOCKS5 Telegram setup before approving proxy-policy work.

options.title: Defer to existing workaround guidance
options.body: Treat the current docs and network knobs as sufficient for now, leaving the issue open only if stronger evidence arrives.

recommendation.title: Review a shared proxy repair
recommendation.body: Use the open candidate or a replacement to fix explicit and env SOCKS/HTTP/HTTPS proxy handling with tests and live Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue sits in the Telegram transport surface and obviyus is the strongest available routing signal from CONTRIBUTING plus Telegram transport history.
